verification_commands.ac1: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"./frontend/package.json\",\"utf8\"));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.devDependencies);const r=[\"react\",\"react-dom\",\"react-router-dom\",\"@tanstack/react-query\",\"axios\",\"tailwindcss\",\"vitest\",\"@testing-library/react\",\"msw\",\"eslint\",\"prettier\",\"typescript\"];const b=r.filter(k=>!d[k]||!/^[0-9]/.test(d[k]));if(b.length){console.error(\"unpinned or missing: \"+b.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}" && git ls-files --error-unmatch frontend/package-lock.json >/dev/null'
verification_commands.ac2: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm install --no-audit --no-fund" >/dev/null'
verification_commands.ac3: bash -c 'test -f frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q createRoot frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q "id=\"root\"" frontend/index.html && ls frontend/tailwind.config.* >/dev/null && grep -RqE "@tailwind (base|components|utilities)" frontend/src --include=*.css && grep -RqE "className=\"[^\"]*(flex|grid|min-h-screen|mx-auto|p-[0-9]|text-[a-z])" frontend/src --include=*.tsx'
verification_commands.ac4: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && find frontend/src -name "*.test.tsx" | grep -q . && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm test -- --run" >/dev/null'
verification_commands.ac5: bash -c 'test -f frontend/tsconfig.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npx tsc --noEmit"'
verification_commands.ac6: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"./frontend/package.json\",\"utf8\"));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.devDependencies);const bad=Object.keys(d).filter(k=>/^(styled-components|@emotion\/|styled-jsx|@stitches\/|@linaria\/|react-native-css)/.test(k)||/^(react-hook-form|zod|recharts|date-fns)$/.test(k));if(bad.length){console.error(\"forbidden or deferred dependency: \"+bad.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}"'

notes: AC refinement: the 6 draft AC were rewritten as observable/checkable statements and numbered ac1-ac6. Draft ac2 ('npm install completes without error') became ac2 with exit-code semantics; draft ac3 (shell renders) was decomposed into concrete file-level evidence (index.html #root, main.tsx createRoot, tailwind.config.*, @tailwind CSS directive, utility className) so it is automatable without a browser; draft ac6 ('no runtime CSS-in-JS') became an executable manifest scan that ALSO enforces the Constraints (no react-hook-form/zod/recharts/date-fns), turning a non-automatable constraint into a checked AC.

REQ-TECH-081 gap closed: the draft mentioned only 'pins versions'; groom added the committed package-lock.json requirement (git ls-files --error-unmatch frontend/package-lock.json in ac1), which is what REQ-TECH-081 actually specifies as verification.

Contract-first: contract_first.require_for = [backend, api, database] and allow_natural_for = [ui, ux]. t2 is a frontend tooling skeleton, not a UI-behavior issue: all 6 AC are structurally observable, so all 6 got executable commands and none is marked 'manual'. Recorded as contract_first_applied = true.

Environment adaptation (critical for Builder/Verifier): node/npm/npx are Windows binaries and 'npx tsx'/node tooling fails from WSL (esbuild platform mismatch, confirmed again this run: 'npx tsx scripts/platform.ts issue get 5' errored). Every toolchain command therefore uses D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && <cmd>". This pattern was verified live: 'cmd.exe /c cd /d <winpath> && npm --version' returned 11.17.0 with exit 0 from the repo. The invocation is documented in the issue body's Verification commands environment note.

Command self-test against CURRENT (pre-implementation) repo: all 6 commands exit non-zero for the correct reason - ac1/ac3/ac4/ac5/ac6 fail on missing frontend/package.json / frontend/src/main.tsx / frontend/tsconfig.json; ac4's 'find frontend/src -name *.test.tsx | grep -q .' guard fails on absence of test files before any npm call.

Command positive-path simulation (/tmp/t2sim scratch git repo with a representative post-implementation frontend): ac1 passed with a fully pinned manifest + tracked package-lock.json; ac3 passed with index.html #root + main.tsx createRoot + tailwind.config.js + @tailwind CSS + utility className, and FAILED when the @tailwind directive was removed (negative check); ac6 passed on the clean manifest and FAILED with 'forbidden or deferred dependency: zod' after adding zod (negative check). ac2/ac4/ac5 could not be fully simulated (no node_modules install in the scratch repo, and cmd.exe cannot cd to the WSL-UNC /tmp path - an artifact of /tmp, not of the repo path); their syntax was validated and the cmd.exe path pattern was proven from the real /mnt/c repo.
ac2/ac4/ac5 sequencing note recorded in the issue body: they require ac2 (npm install) to have run first because they need node_modules; the Verifier must run ac2 before ac4/ac5.

Draft AC 'Dev server builds the app shell' (plan.md template) was intentionally NOT made an AC: starting a dev server is non-deterministic/port-dependent. It is covered deterministically by ac3 (static wiring) + ac5 (tsc) + ac4 (vitest render). REQ-PLAN-012 'frontend starts' is thus checked via build/test/typecheck rather than a live server.

Granularity: 6 AC == limits.issue_granularity.max_acs (6), warn_only = true; max_files = 4 is exceeded by design for a tooling skeleton. Recorded in the issue Context; scope explicitly capped there ('Do not inflate the scope further').
